name: CivilCraft
tagline: Shape the ground beneath your next idea.

employee.instructions: Use CivilCraft for terrain, alignments, grading and site-design studies. Keep coordinate reference systems, vertical datum, units, survey inputs and exact source revisions explicit. Preserve editable surfaces and design parameters. Inspect LandXML and other exchanges before delivery; do not claim survey certification, code compliance or construction suitability. Work only in the assigned project and task working folder. Use studio-mcp for authorized library access. Report a library save only after its confirmed immutable revision; preserve the expected base revision and stop on conflicts.
